title: Halliburton Xaminer® Deep Testing logging service for expanded reservoir insight and improved operational efficiency
summary: Halliburton launches the Xaminer Deep Testing logging service, delivering early deep-reading producibility and boundary insights to complement DST.
body_markdown:
#### Xaminer® Deep Testing logging service


Xaminer Deep Testing logging service delivers deep-reading reservoir insight, pressure transient analysis, and deliverability screening while operational risk
